propositions: When structured-parse retries exhaust in _pai_structured's prompted branch, the final raw reply is discarded and the failure is not replayable unless opt-in artifact capture is configured.

A new optional config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir (default None, resolved in LLMConfig via _llm_str and env var REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR) enables writing timestamped artifacts containing raw reply, model id, contract name, and attempt count to a configured directory on final parse failure.
The artifact write is best-effort and local-only: unset key preserves today's behavior byte-for-byte, I/O errors never mask the original parse error, and the directory is created if absent.
After writing an artifact, oldest-by-mtime files are pruned to keep at most 20 per directory to prevent unbounded growth on unattended hosts.
